A very long preamble about tomatoes, twelve summers in a row of them, and a villa I once saw a photo of.

Back-Pocket Marinara

  • 28 oz crushed tomatoes
  • 4 tbsp butter
  • 1 yellow onion, halved
  • 1 tsp kosher salt
Put everything in a pot over medium-low heat.
Simmer 45 minutes, stirring now and then.
Fish out the onion, season, and toss with anything.
